turns.spongebob: Squidward! SQUIDWARD! Open the door, it's an emergency!
turns.squidward: [flat, exhausted] [long sigh] Oh, wonderful. Screaming at eight in the morning. [muttering to himself] I'm all the way in the back, SpongeBob, go have your <emphasis>emergency</emphasis> somewhere else.

turns.spongebob: Please please PLEASE open up, Squidward! I’m begging on my knees and my square knees are getting rug burn!
turns.squidward: [dry, unimpressed] [scoff] Then stop kneeling on my welcome mat, genius. [flat, exhausted] I'm busy, and I'm very, very far from that door.

turns.spongebob: I can hear your beautiful clarinet from out here, Squidward! You're like the Mozart of the sea — just open up so I can hear it better!
turns.squidward: [pompous, savoring every word] Hmph. Mozart of the sea... finally someone recognizes true genius. [flat, exhausted] Still not opening, SpongeBob, I'm practicing way in the back.

turns.spongebob: Squidward, your house is on fire! I see smoke! Smell clarinet-melting smoke! Open the door quick!
turns.squidward: [suddenly shrill] What?! My paintings! My clarinet! [muttering to himself] Where are my keys... where are my stupid house slippers... [flat, annoyed] This better not be one of your idiotic jokes, SpongeBob.

turns.spongebob: Ahem! Squidward me boy, this be Mr. Krabs! Open up, I need me rent money right now!
turns.squidward: [suspicious, narrowing eyes] Mr. Krabs? You sound suspiciously square and squeaky today. [groan] Ugh, if that's really him... where did I leave those keys...

turns.spongebob: Forget rent! I've got a hot Krabby Patty with extra pickles right here for you, Squidward!
turns.squidward: [grumbling, closer] Oh, dragging me all the way to the foyer with a patty bribe... [clears throat] Hold on, I'm undoing the top lock... and this stupid chain is stuck again...

turns.spongebob: Open up or I'll sing the WHOLE Camping Song right here — C-A-M-P-F-I-R-E S-O-N-G!
turns.squidward: [panicked, shrill] No! Not the camping song! Anything but that! [grumbling] I'm coming, I'm coming... just... let me get this bolt... it's jammed...

turns.spongebob: You'll feel REAL guilty if Gary gets stung out there 'cause you wouldn't open up!
turns.squidward: [exasperated, fumbling] Guilt-tripping me with Gary now? Low, even for you. [muttering to himself] Almost there... one more bolt... this blasted lock never turns right...

turns.spongebob: I'll clean your whole house! Bathrooms! Baseboards! I'll even dust your clarinets!
turns.squidward: [low, tired] Hand's on the knob already... [pause] Just give me one... more... <slow>second</slow>...

turns.spongebob: Squidward, NOW! The jellyfish swarm's here and Gary's trapped inside your house!
turns.squidward: [suddenly alarmed] Gary? Inside MY house? [groan] Fine! Come in and get him before he slimes the carpet!
